nav.label: Main

hero.lead: A real Chrome, self-hosted on your own server. Your agents drive it over MCP; you open it from any computer and take over for 2FA. Start a persistent session and its logins stay on your server, with no usage fees.
for.label: Who it’s for
for.agents.title: For your agents
for.agents.text: Claude Code, Codex or any agent drives it over MCP or the API. When it hits a login or a 2FA code, you take over; it waits, then carries on. What you type in password fields never reaches it.
for.you.title: For you
for.you.text: Keep your sensitive accounts logged in on your server, not on your laptop, and open them from any computer. You sign in to your admin with your password, 2FA if you turn it on, or a passkey, and saved sessions are encrypted with a key your password unlocks.
